name: Investment, Ponzi and Pyramid Schemes
description: Operators promise unusually high or guaranteed returns, paying earlier investors from new deposits or recruitment fees rather than genuine profits. Collapse leaves many victims and often a trail of commingled funds and layered transfers.

sources.text: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)
IOSCO, investor alerts on unregistered investment offerings (general)
ACFE, Occupational Fraud 2024: A Report to the Nations (2024)

exposure.rationale: Investor deposits to operators; crypto and securities variants.

indicators.name: Promised returns far above market with low stated risk
indicators.canon: Promised returns far above market with low stated risk
indicators.desc: Operator marketing guarantees consistently high returns, often with testimonials and urgency; victims relay these claims when transferring.
indicators.ctx: Operator marketing guarantees consistently high returns, often with testimonials and urgency; victims relay these claims when transferring.
indicators.fp: Genuine high-risk, high-return products clearly disclosed.
refs: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)

indicators.name: Many small inflows from unrelated individuals into one account
indicators.canon: Many unrelated senders paying a single account or recipient
indicators.desc: Numerous unrelated payers send frequent, often small, payments to one account, wallet or beneficiary, or one funder pays many beneficiaries, with no clear commercial relationship.
indicators.ctx: Operator-side: numerous retail credits referencing the 'investment' or a referral code, inconsistent with the stated business.
indicators.fp: Crowdfunding, clubs or bonafide pooled schemes.
refs: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)

indicators.name: Outflows paying earlier investors in matching round amounts
indicators.canon: Outflows paying earlier investors in matching round amounts
indicators.desc: Operator-side: credits are followed by payments to prior investors in neat sums, plus cash-outs to insiders.
indicators.ctx: Operator-side: credits are followed by payments to prior investors in neat sums, plus cash-outs to insiders.
refs: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)

indicators.name: Recruitment-based rewards or tiered commissions
indicators.desc: Payments reward introducing new participants rather than selling goods or services.
indicators.ctx: Payments reward introducing new participants rather than selling goods or services.
indicators.fp: Standard multi-level marketing with genuine retail sales.
refs: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)

indicators.name: Unregistered or unlicensed operator
indicators.canon: Unlicensed or cloned operator receiving payments
indicators.desc: Payments go to operators, platforms or merchants that are absent from regulatory registers, imitate a legitimate firm, or process under a disguised merchant category.
indicators.ctx: Operator is absent from regulator registers or holds a licence unrelated to the activity offered.
refs: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)

indicators.name: Delays or fees when investors request withdrawals
indicators.canon: Delays or fees when investors request withdrawals
indicators.desc: customers report blocked withdrawals or demands for charges and taxes; complaints rise.
indicators.ctx: Victim-side: customers report blocked withdrawals or demands for charges and taxes; complaints rise.
refs: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)

indicators.name: Investor funds diverted to personal assets or luxury spending
indicators.canon: Investor funds diverted to personal assets or luxury spending
indicators.desc: Operator-side: lifestyle spending, property or vehicle purchases funded from investor accounts.
indicators.ctx: Operator-side: lifestyle spending, property or vehicle purchases funded from investor accounts.
refs: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)

indicators.name: Customer borrowing to invest or reinvesting returns repeatedly
indicators.canon: Customer borrowing to invest or reinvesting returns repeatedly
indicators.desc: customer takes credit or rolls over supposed profits and refers friends.
indicators.ctx: Victim-side: customer takes credit or rolls over supposed profits and refers friends.
refs: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)

indicators.name: Operator accounts opened in many names or institutions
indicators.canon: Operator accounts opened in many names or institutions
indicators.desc: Accounts are repeatedly opened and closed under front companies to receive deposits.
indicators.ctx: Accounts are repeatedly opened and closed under front companies to receive deposits.
refs: FATF, guidance on risk-based approach and proceeds of fraud (general)
